name: VetStack
tagline: A savings desk for military life, from purchases to benefits
description: Built by a veteran for the whole military household, it takes money one decision at a time: purchase search, project spending plans, subscription reviews, receipt audits, and pointers to benefits already earned. The optional vendor email scan stays off until asked for.
body:
## What it does

Built by a veteran for the whole military household, it takes money one decision at a time: purchase search, project spending plans, subscription reviews, receipt audits, and pointers to benefits already earned. The optional vendor email scan stays off until asked for.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @kenashe shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
